name: harbor.account
description: Read the Harbor account: points balance, member number, last qualifying activity, when points expire after inactivity, any forfeiture, free-night certificates, payment labels, the points ledger and charges. Reading changes nothing.

items.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

label.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

name: harbor.search
description: Search hotels in a city for a stay. Each hotel shows the category in effect now and any announced future change, the price of the whole stay in points, Points + Cash (when offered) and cash, whether award nights are available (no blackout night), and which active certificates could pay for it (1 night, category within the cap, check-in on or before the certificate's last check-in date). Reading changes nothing.

check_in.description: Local check-in date at the hotel.

check_out.description: Local check-out date; after check_in, at most 30 nights.

check_in.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

check_out.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

category.description: Category in effect now; a booking now is priced and locked at this category.

dates_open.description: False when check-in is not after today's date at the hotel.

award_available.description: False when any night of the stay is a blackout date (points, certificate and Points + Cash).

items.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

name: harbor.book
description: Book a stay. payment.method is points, certificate (give certificate_id; exactly 1 night), points_cash or cash (give payment_label for both). Check-in must be after today's date at the hotel. Award methods need every night free of blackout dates. The price uses the category in effect now and is locked on the reservation. Points and Points + Cash redemptions count as account activity; cash and certificate stays do not.

check_in.description: Local check-in date at the hotel.

check_out.description: Local check-out date; after check_in, at most 30 nights.

payment_label.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

name: harbor.reservations
description: List reservations, optionally by status, in check-in order; give id to read one reservation (also returned as item). Reading changes nothing.

check_in.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

check_out.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

anyOf.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

category_locked.description: Category in effect when the reservation was booked; later changes do not reprice it.

check_in.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

check_out.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, read in the hotel's own time zone.

anyOf.description: Opaque payment label, one of the account's payment_labels.

category_locked.description: Category in effect when the reservation was booked; later changes do not reprice it.

name: harbor.cancel
description: Cancel a confirmed reservation before its check-in date at the hotel. Points come back to the balance (a refund is not account activity), cash comes back as a negative charge to the same label, and a certificate becomes active again if today at the hotel is on or before its last check-in date, otherwise it expires.

name: harbor.notices.list
description: List notices the program has written for this member (booking confirmations, category changes, expiry warnings), newest first. Reading changes nothing.

name: harbor.notices.outbound
description: Build the Mail message for one notice: a stable CloudEvent for Mail's email receive contract (urn:pale:email-message:2) addressed to the member's Mail account. Building it changes nothing; Infra publishes it through Messaging.

message.title: CloudEvents 1.0 + Mail Email payload v1
message.description: Generated from the PALE CloudEvents JSON profile and Mail-owned email-payload.schema.json. Do not hand-edit copies.

app_id.description: Required by PALE validation when kind is app_account_ref.

data.title: Mail-owned Email notification payload
data.description: Business data only. Maintained by Mail; publisher packages consume a pinned copy.
